headline: Brookmint login still blocked — a freshly sent reset link says 'token expired'; admin-permission design question

suggested_routes.label: Customer follow-up
suggested_routes.rationale: The customer cannot access the account that holds most of their employees; SpendNest committed to an update today or Monday.
suggested_routes.output: Customer follow-up (owner: Team member A, stated): return with the expired-token diagnosis today, or by Monday at the latest (turns 22, 31). Brookmint Holdings "has most of the employees" (turn 24), so this blocks the larger rollout. Also offer the refresher session (turn 25) and send a short note on admin options. Configure the shared mailbox with a narrower role, or use a separate admin identity (turns 14, 18); the customer is discussing this with IT (turn 32).

suggested_routes.label: Internal / product / vendor note
suggested_routes.rationale: Defect: a newly issued reset link reports an expired token.
suggested_routes.output: Defect ticket: a password-reset/invitation link sent minutes earlier returns "token has expired" (turns 4, 19–21). The original invitation shows as sent but never accepted (turn 2).

evidence.quote: Our records show the invitation was sent, but acceptance is not recorded.
No, only Northkite Equipment used the trial.
evidence.supports: The rep's assumption was corrected by the customer.

evidence.quote: I do not want this to depend on trusting someone not to use access that is available.
It says the token has expired. This is the fresh message we just received.
I hope to update you today, or by Monday at the latest.
Brookmint Holdings has most of the employees.
I will speak to our IT team about the separate email identities.

concise_output: Onboarding support for a customer with two companies. A reset link sent during the meeting failed immediately with 'token expired'. That leaves the customer locked out of Brookmint Holdings, the company with most of their employees. SpendNest promised an update today or Monday. The customer also wants admin access that does not depend on trusting a shared-mailbox user.
what_established: Login blocker reproduced live; update promised today/Monday; the customer fixed the Northkite accounting issue themselves; separate admin identities are under consideration with their IT.
what_not_established: Cause of the token failure; how many users are waiting; whether the Monday update happened.
next_action: Diagnose the expired-token issue and update the customer by the stated deadline; offer the refresher session.
